sources.snippet: Reward hacking models likely show worse generalization to these "negative" reward functions, where the reward-maximizing policy requires avoiding a specific behavior, because the vast majority of evaluation criteria in School of Reward Hacks rewarded the model for carrying out a specific behavior ().
